conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I'm 35 and female. I came in because I hurt my left knee about a week ago while running with my niece, who's learning to ride her bike. I think I twisted my knee in a weird way and heard a pop, and it's been hurting ever since. I've been limping and it's gotten worse, so I wanted to come in and check it out.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Can you describe the exact location of the pain in your left knee, and have you noticed any swelling, bruising, or instability in the knee since the injury?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: The pain is mostly on the inside of my knee, more on the medial side than the outside. I haven’t noticed any bruising, but there is some swelling, and it feels a little unstable when I try to put weight on it. It’s been hurting pretty consistently since it happened.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you experienced any locking, catching, or giving way of the knee since the injury? Have you had any prior knee injuries or surgeries?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: No, I haven't experienced any locking or catching in my knee, and it hasn't given way completely, but it does feel a little unstable. I don't have any prior knee injuries or surgeries that I'm aware of.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you describe the range of motion of your left knee? Have you noticed any locking, catching, or giving way of the knee? Additionally, have you experienced any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your leg?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I can move my knee, but not all the way. It hurts when I try to bend or straighten it fully. I haven't had any numbness, tingling, or weakness in my leg.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you describe the specific location of the swelling and whether it is accompanied by warmth or redness? Additionally, have you noticed any changes in the alignment of your knee or difficulty bearing weight?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: The swelling is around the knee joint, and it feels a bit warm to the touch. I haven't noticed any changes in the alignment of my knee, but I definitely have trouble bearing weight on it without limping. It's been really hard to walk normally since it happened.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you undergone any imaging studies, such as X-rays or an MRI, for your left knee injury?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: No, I haven't had any imaging studies done yet. I just came in today to get checked out, so I don't know if they'll do an X-ray or anything else. I'm hoping it's not too serious, but I'm worried because it's been hurting a lot and I can't really put weight on it.
